bias.en: Bearish · broke the October lows, SAR flipped bearish
bias.zh: 看空 · 跌破 10月低点，SAR 翻空

read.en: Lumentum fell 18.6% on Nov 2 to $684.40, trading between $679.00 and $800.12 on 2.9 times average volume. It is below the rising 5-day ($845.0) and 200-day ($802.9) and the falling 10-day ($822.5), 100-day ($866.8) and 30-day ($929.1) averages. MACD has been below its signal since Oct 13 and below zero, histogram widening; Parabolic SAR flipped bearish on Nov 2 ($978.4), and RSI is 35.
read.zh: Lumentum 11月2日大跌 18.6%，收于 $684.40，盘中区间 $679.00–800.12，成交量为均量的 2.9 倍。股价位于上行的 5 日（$845.0）和 200 日均线（$802.9）以及下行的 10 日（$822.5）、100 日（$866.8）和 30 日均线（$929.1）下方。MACD 自 10月13日起位于信号线下方且在零轴之下，柱状图放大；抛物线 SAR 于 11月2日翻空（$978.4），RSI 为 35。

read.en: The drop broke every written support — $832–838, the 200-day and $805, and the $736–746 October lows — which now act as resistance. Resistance is $736.0–746.2, then $800.1–805.3 (Nov 2 high, 200-day, Oct 30 low) and $822.5–845.0 (10 and 5-day). Support is $679–683 (Nov 2 low, Jul 7–8 lows), then $650–651 (July lows) and $594.8–602.3. A close above $746 would target $800–805; below $679, $650.

r.en: Oct 23 low $736.0 and Oct 22 low $746.2, lost

s.en: Nov 2 low $679; Jul 7 and Jul 8 lows ($680.4–683.4)
